Install your effect.

Your ZIP contains a complete effect definition and its image, when used.

  1. Export effectDownload your ready-to-install ZIP.
  2. Extract into plugins/FrameUI/Merge the effects/ and images/ folders. Keep your other files.
  3. Run /frameui reloadFrameUI validates definitions and rebuilds its resource pack.
  4. Test in gameAccept the refreshed pack, then run /frameui preview <id>.

A new ID creates a separate effect. An existing ID replaces that definition. Your drafts and photos stay in this browser until you export.
